message.content: Yes, weather affects how far a drone can fly. Batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned, so I have to be extra careful when those conditions are expected. I don’t get weather forecasts through the service, but I know that if a drone’s battery runs low because of bad weather, it might not make it to its destination—or might even restart in flight if it crashes. That’s why I always double-check the drone’s battery status and the conditions before sending it out.
